subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should OpenClaw resolve this TUI item by documenting the current pi-tui newline defaults and fallbacks only, or approve a public TUI send/newline keybinding preference?
rationale: Current main already has dependency-backed default multiline input, but configurable Enter/Ctrl+Enter/Shift+Enter behavior would add public TUI config, CLI, or keybinding surface that repository policy treats as high-bar product direction.

options.title: Document Defaults First
options.body: Add TUI docs and /help coverage for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and the backslash-enter fallback while keeping Enter-to-send as the only OpenClaw-owned default.

options.title: Add TUI Keybinding Config
options.body: Approve a narrow config or CLI bridge into pi-tui keybindings with focused tests for default behavior, configured behavior, and help/docs copy.

options.title: Decline Configurable Keybindings
options.body: Keep dependency defaults only and close the configurable-keybinding part by maintainer decision after docs clarify the supported composition flow.

recommendation.title: Document Defaults First
recommendation.body: Add TUI docs and /help coverage for Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and the backslash-enter fallback while keeping Enter-to-send as the only OpenClaw-owned default.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already reviewed this exact TUI docs/config remainder and is the clearest owner from current TUI source/docs history.
